verdict.rationale: Dover's own API lets you programmatically add candidates, fetch jobs and automate recruitment processes, so the product can be driven headlessly. Nothing documents a CLI, CI integration or headless run mode, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: an official CLI or documented CI/pipeline usage, a published OpenAPI spec, API auth and endpoint depth, independent hands-on corroboration of headless automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: With the API, you can programmatically add candidates to your jobs, fetch job listings, and automate various recruitment processes.
